title: Adventure Time
description: Hook up with Finn and Jake as they travel the Land of Ooo searching for adventure. But remember, adventure isn’t always easy. Sometimes you’ve got to battle fire gnomes that torture old ladies, save a smelly hot dog princess from the Ice King, and thaw out a bunch of frozen businessmen. What the cabbage?!

episodes.title: S5-E22The Party's Over, Isla de Señorita

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x1
episodes_data.description: Finn and Princess Bubblegum must protect the Candy Kingdom from a horde of candy zombies they accidentally created.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x2
episodes_data.description: Finn must travel to Lumpy Space to find a cure that will save Jake, who was accidentally bitten by Lumpy Space Princess at a tea party.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x3
episodes_data.description: When the Ice King kidnaps a number of princesses he sees as potential brides, Finn and Jake team with the prisoners to set everybody free.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x4
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake join Tree Trunks in search for the rare Crystal Gem Apple, but question whether Tree Trunks has what it takes to adventure.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x5
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake go on a quest for a magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x6
episodes_data.description: A jiggly creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing follows Finn and Jake home but soon feels ill effects of separation from its family.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x7
episodes_data.description: When a Heart Guy named Ricardio comes to Candy Kingdom, Finn gets really jealous and finds a way to get him out of the Land of Ooo.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x8
episodes_data.description: When Finn and Jake discover a group of businessmen frozen in an iceberg, the duo thaws them and hires them to help with their adventures.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x9
episodes_data.description: Jake's plan to spend time with both Lady Rainicorn and Finn backfires.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x10
episodes_data.description: Finn reflects on an upsetting experience in his past and pledges to help everyone in town, but this proves more difficult than imagined.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x11
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake temporarily get magic powers from an evil wizard, but are tricked into helping stop a comet.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x12
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x13
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake go off to face a thief king who has been stealing from little girls.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x14
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake consider breaking up after a witch strips Jake of his powers.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x15
episodes_data.description: Finn brings a pie-throwing robot to life, but the machine begins to long for a more fulfilling existence.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x16
episodes_data.description: Finn struggles to overcome his fear of the ocean.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x17
episodes_data.description: The Ice King gets married but not before he convinces Finn and Jake to throw him a manlorette party.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x18
episodes_data.description: Finn's headstrong decision to explore a dungeon in defiance of Jake's warnings leads to a dangerous escapade.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x19
episodes_data.description: Finn must tell the truth when he accidentally turns Princess Bubblegum bald and green and blames the Duke of Nuts.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x20
episodes_data.description: After being transformed into a foot, Finn joins forces with a band of misfits to make things right.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x21
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake try to help an obnoxious grass ogre named Donny develop better social skills, only to find out Donny's jerky behavior protects the house people from the why-wolves, which eat the house people.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x22
episodes_data.description: After seeing Marceline the vampire queen torment an elderly henchman, Finn steps in to be her new henchman, doing whatever he is told to do.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x23
episodes_data.description: Stuck inside the treehouse due to a knife storm, Finn and Jake use their imagination to pass the time.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x24
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake capture the Ice King as their prisoner, but feel guilty when unable to explain the wrongs he committed.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 1x25
episodes_data.description: The great warrior Billy inspires Finn and Jake to practice nonviolence, but the duo finds it difficult to resist old ways.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x1
episodes_data.description: Marceline's evil father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after Finn and Marceline accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x2
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x3
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake are excited to meet the Nice King who has come to Ooo. They soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know; the Ice King.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Finn gets a splinter on his finger, he wants to get the best armor. In order to receive it, he must go on a quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon and survive one embarrassing situation after another.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x5
episodes_data.description: Jake is sick and demands to hear a good story full of romance, fighting and suspense.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x6
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake agree to help a snail named Snorlock find a girlfriend.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x7
episodes_data.description: Finn is captured by gnomes who want to use his energy to power their infernal machines, and it's up to Jake to stay focused and rescue him.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x8
episodes_data.description: Jake takes a pledge of nonviolence just before Finn is kidnapped by outlaws from the crystalline dimension.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x9
episodes_data.description: Finn choses to cross the Desert of Doom to deliver the royal tarts to the annual back rubbing ceremony.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x10
episodes_data.description: A tree witch demands a lock of princess hair or else Jake will be sucked into her bottomless bottom.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x11
episodes_data.description: Whilst the Ice King goes out to take Gunther to the hospital, Finn and Jake decide to sneak inside his lair and flex their ninja skills.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x12
episodes_data.description: Jake's relationship with Lady Rainicorn is in danger when he promises to meet with her parents, as both species had a long history of war with each other. However, thanks to Jake's shape-shifting powers, they mistake the dog as one of their own, but for how long?

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x13
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake discover a box containing three beans. Planting them causes three pods to grow. Two of them are good and one is evil, but which is which?

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x14
episodes_data.description: After defeating a evil king of goblins, Finn finds himself crowned as their new king. Unfortunately, he's unable to do anything for them due to the rules of the previous king including defending the goblins from the previous king.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x15
episodes_data.description: Finn has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue and seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x16
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake get sucked into one of BMO's games and they have to defeat all three of his bosses.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x17
episodes_data.description: After killing Princess Bubblegum's plant when left to take care of it, Finn and Jake make a trip to the Land of the Dead in order to get it's soul back.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x18
episodes_data.description: Finn is excited to discover what appears to be a tribe of humans living underground near the Candy Kingdom, but gets more than he expected when he tries to teach one of them about the surface world.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x19
episodes_data.description: Wanting to surprise Finn on his birthday, Jake takes Finn on a train, where they get wrapped up in a murder mystery.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x20
episodes_data.description: Marceline and Jake give Finn advice so he can ask Princess Bubblegum to see a movie with him.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x21
episodes_data.description: In order to cure the stomach ache of a giant, Finn and Jake must break up a party happening in his belly.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x22
episodes_data.description: On a mission to save soldiers of the Hot Dog Princess, Finn and Jake go inside a massive maze where wishes can be granted and where Jake's stretching powers are pushed to their limits.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x23
episodes_data.description: After discovering government warnings prior to movies for their film club, Finn and Jake decide to make their own, but get into a fight over the direction of their film.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x24
episodes_data.description: When the Lich is accidentally freed from its amber prison in Princess Bubblegum's Castle, Finn and Jake must head forth to stop it from regaining its full power, all while being pestered by the Ice King to give him their blessing to marry Princess Bubblegum.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x25
episodes_data.description: Princess Bubblegum recovers from being dropped in the Well of Power by the Ice King; however, she is altered and her condition leads to an unlikely final showdown with one of the greatest evils in order to save all life in Ooo.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 2x26
episodes_data.description: Marceline plays a prank on Finn and Jake by making them believe they're vampires, but it goes too far and escalates when they're manipulated by her ghost friends.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x1
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x2
episodes_data.description: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to bloodlust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x3
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x4
episodes_data.description: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to attack Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x6
episodes_data.description: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x7
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake are literally unable to move and are at the mercy of the Ice King.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x8
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x9
episodes_data.description: In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake must battle the evil Ice Queen.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x10
episodes_data.description: Finn and his friends must come together as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and get back their taken items.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x11
episodes_data.description: When Tree Trunks's apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x12
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x13
episodes_data.description: When another plague of Candy Zombies arises and Princess Bubblegum is among the undead, Finn and his friends are in a race against time to figure out how to stop it...without making things even worse!

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x14
episodes_data.description: Susan Strong asks Finn and Jake to help fight off the Glub Glubs in the sewers below to regain her people's home in Beautopia.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x15
episodes_data.description: Finn awakens after an accident to find the Candy Kingdom citizens mysteriously gone and Jake acting crazier than usual.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x16
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake take on a request to protect Wildberry Princess from an unknown assassin. The assassin turns out to be a tiny cat assassin called Me-Mow, who ends up bribing Jake by poisoning him.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Snow Golem visits the Fire Kingdom and finds an unlikely follower.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x18
episodes_data.description: Jake dreams about his death, and Finn takes action when events from the dream start to come true.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x19
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake find the Ice King's video diary and have a chance to unearth his secrets.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x20
episodes_data.description: The Ice King summons an army of snowmen to recover the secret tapes Finn and Jake are watching. They must work against the clock to find out the secrets enclosed within.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x21
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake play Cloud Hunt in Marceline's house, but they get trapped in her closet after she comes home.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 3x22
episodes_data.description: Library books seek help from Finn and Jake to save them from the evil Moldari.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x1
episodes_data.description: Part 2 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x2
episodes_data.description: Part 3 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x3
episodes_data.description: A series of short stories all centered around a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x4
episodes_data.description: The guys' game of catch goes awry when their throwing disc is lodged in a large tree.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x5
episodes_data.description: Finn receives a bag full of miniature versions of his friends.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x6
episodes_data.description: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x7
episodes_data.description: Finn creates an alter ego, Davey. Davey soon begins to take over, and Jake is forced into action to get his old friend back.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x8
episodes_data.description: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby, and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x9
episodes_data.description: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x10
episodes_data.description: Finn's hat comes to life and becomes evil after it is touched by a wizard. Finn, Jake, and the wizard track the hat down, and manage to turn the hat good.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x11
episodes_data.description: The princesses tire of Ice King’s crazy Fionna-and-Cake fan-fiction stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how to properly write a story.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x12
episodes_data.description: When Flame Princess begins to doubt her evilness, Finn insists she is not evil and takes her on a journey into a dungeon to help her sort out her thoughts.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x13
episodes_data.description: Xergiok, the former Goblin king who was deposed by Finn and Jake claims to have turned over a new leaf.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x14
episodes_data.description: A look at what Ice King and Marceline were like 996 years ago.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x15
episodes_data.description: The Ice King creates a computer virus that will delete everyone in Ooo except for him and Princess Bubblegum. Finn and Jake hack into the universal source code to destroy the virus.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x16
episodes_data.description: Finn dreams he is in a pillow world where he marries a pillow woman  and has two children with her.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x17
episodes_data.description: BMO makes his way home after being snatched by an eagle. On its way, BMO meets Bubble and a baby, and the three decide to journey home together.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x18
episodes_data.description: Ice King gets super jealous when he finds out that he wasn't invited to the Princess Potluck.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x19
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake stumble across a horse named James Baxter who has the ability to make sad people feel better.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x20
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake make a bet to see who can not talk the longest, and the two use signs to communicate.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x21
episodes_data.description: Peppermint Butler thinks that Bubblegum is working too hard in her lab, so he tries to get her a suitor.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x22
episodes_data.description: After another one of his schemes fails, the Ice King decides to give up.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x23
episodes_data.description: Jake Jr. gets involved with a group of troublemakers, and Jake is forced to reunite his old gang—which includes Tiffany who first appeared in the first season episode "My Two Favorite People"—to rescue his daughter.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x24
episodes_data.description: A series of short stories with a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future. In this entry, Finn and Jake build a time machine. Meanwhile, Princess Bubblegum helps Cinnamon Bun overcome his fear of the dark.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x25
episodes_data.description: Lumpy Space Princess is robbed, but before she is able to explain the details to Finn and Jake, she faints.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 5x26
episodes_data.description: After Starchy comes down with a cold and needs a magic cure, Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum disguise themselves as wizards and sneak into Wizard City.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x1
episodes_data.description: In order to find Finn's father, Finn and Jake must commit a cosmic crime...unless the Lich beats them to it.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x2
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake follow the Lich to the Citadel, where Finn meets his long lost dad. But just how far does the apple fall from the tree?

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x3
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake discover that Clone James has been faking his own death to collect medals. Now there are 25 Jameses running amok!

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x4
episodes_data.description: Finn doesn't like any of the new arms the princesses give him, so he builds a tower into space to find his dad and get his old arm back. But are his hopes up a little too high?

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x5
episodes_data.description: Once a month, while Jake's asleep, his tail stretches out of the tree house to go work as a clown in a traveling bug circus.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x6
episodes_data.description: With a friendly bee named "Breezy" as his wingman, Finn decides to get back into the dating game.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x7
episodes_data.description: On a field trip to the Candy Kingdom Museum of Natural History, Finn and Jake learn about the food chain by becoming the food chain!

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x8
episodes_data.description: Big money problems send Finn and Jake to Wildberry Kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x9
episodes_data.description: The beautiful and sensitive Lumpy Space Prince flees his cruel parents to start a new life.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x10
episodes_data.description: Princess Bubblegum must rally her forces when the Candy Kingdom is rocked by a massive assault.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x11
episodes_data.description: Shelby the worm discovers that he has a little brother who is bound for adventure in the nooks of Marceline's tree house.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x12
episodes_data.description: Fed up with Jake's antics, his son Kim Kil Whan takes action.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x13
episodes_data.description: Ice King and a band of misfit wizards go on a mystical road trip.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x14
episodes_data.description: It's Princess Day in Ooo! You know what that means? Yep, LSP and Marceline team up to prank Breakfast Princess!

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x15
episodes_data.description: A shadowy figure named Peace Master targets the Candy Kingdom elite.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x16
episodes_data.description: Finn and Jake's parents hunt an unearthly menace in the woods.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x17
episodes_data.description: Jake and the tree house are haunted by a vengeful specter.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x18
episodes_data.description: Jake finds himself trapped in a world made of himself.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x19
episodes_data.description: Following an ally's memorial service, Jake begins acting strangely.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x20
episodes_data.description: Jake wants to fulfill a bizarre lifelong ambition.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x21
episodes_data.description: When Finn's toothache gets too much to take, he has no choice but to go see dentist.

episodes_data.title: Adventure Time 6x22
episodes_data.description: When the Fire Kingdom is struck by a natural disaster, Flame Princess turns to an unlikely ally.
